en: Sepia-toned historic street scene showing a European town square with a central market fountain featuring animal sculptures (notably stags) and a human statue on a pedestal. Surrounding the fountain are multi‑story townhouses with steep tiled roofs and shops at street level. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the cobblestone streets, and a few early automobiles are visible. German signage appears on several buildings.
